comments.author: Lancelot
comments.body: I can get pretty much get any pet now but think I'm going back to the owl. He just seems to look the coolest when fed and they are bad-ass animals that a lot of people don't realize how underrate-dly tough they are. Even the Panda is cool but I still like the owl...
